$comment: THE declaration of omx-test-pool-voice, a test plugin: a sine voice per held note that renders each voice as one task of the CLAP thread pool and burns a fixed amount of CPU per frame in every voice, so a host's pool can be measured. Events are taken at the block start. The sum of the voices is the same bits whichever thread rendered which voice.
name: omx test-pool-voice
description: A test instrument that offers clap.thread-pool: one sine per held note, each voice one pool task with a fixed CPU load per frame.
